subject: Your first month of sound DNA
preview_text: 28 days in, here's what your headphones have been telling us about you.
body_paragraphs: You’ve been with Loudify for 28 days. That’s 4 weeks of your audio life mapped out — every playlist, every podcast, every game session where the volume slider just wasn’t enough. And we’ve been listening back.

Your Sound DNA report just dropped. It’s not a gimmick — it shows exactly how you’ve been tuning your world. How many times you pushed past the system limit, which profile you leaned on most (music vs. gaming vs. movies), and the precise frequencies you boosted. This is your listening fingerprint, and it’s getting sharper every week.

Here’s the part that matters: your AutoEQ has already learned your headphones. Next time you connect them, they’ll tune instantly — no resets, no fuss. Plus, the weekly recap is your personal scorecard. See how your sound habits stack up against the top listeners on the leaderboard. You’re already in the game.

Open Loudify now and check your Sound DNA for Month One. One tap. Then see where you land on the weekly streaks board. P.S. The last 100 listeners who looked at their first-month recap upgraded to Premium within a week — the full +200% boost and all 200+ headphone presets are waiting.
